entities.summary: The Battle of Pelham, also known as the Battle of Pell's Point, was a battle fought between British and American troops during the New York and New Jersey campaign of the American Revolutionary War. The conflict took place in an area of the Manor of Pelham, covering what is now part of the villages of Pelham Manor and Pelham in Westchester County, New York and Pelham Bay Park in the Bronx, New York City.
